Reservations are confirmed in acknowledgement that the interruption of these services caused by the provider will not result in the termination of the reservation or any type of refunds.Other this to note:We spray for bugs with a professional on a regularly basis but please have in mind that the suite is in a forest area and the space is created in a inside/outside space which still might have bugs in a natural forest setting.Important: RESERVATIONS IN MAY AND JUNE IN PUERTO RICO THERES A NATURAL PHENOMENON. We left all the lights off because the first couple of hard rains in May and June every year makes termites in the trees hatch, these fly all over the island and are attracted by light. It's very difficult to predict when they are going to hatch. The first couple of hard rains in May every year makes termites in the trees hatch, these fly all over the island and are attracted by light. It's very difficult to predict when they are going to hatch. There’s no way to exterminate them as they are in almost every three in Puerto Rico and attracted by light. They are harmless but a pain to clean.They fly during the night of a very hard rain, it is VERY IMPORTANT that you leave all the LIGHTS OFF inside the apartment when you leave or while you are in there because these flying termites will come in. It's very hard to predict the date but I know it's around this time of the year.Please TURN OFF ALL the light when expected to come back at night or when leaving at night or if you are in the apartment and see flying bugs do so as well. description: Casa Mimosa features fresh updates and a remodel, it has the best location in Puntas Rincon. This safe, gated property features an amazing pool & views. The home is an 8-minute walk to Sandy Beach, Casa Verde, & Tamboo. Mimosa has plenty of activities and every comfort you could need. We feature new ACs in all bedrooms & living room, high-end mattresses, a pool table, ping pong, darts, an automatic generator, backup water, & a 75” TV. You'll never want to go home after a trip to Casa Mimosa.The spaceLocation: This home is located on one of the best streets in the premier Puntas neighborhood of Rincon. You can walk down to get an espresso or acai bowl at Jakes Java. Instead of going straight you can turn right and get a burger and beer at Casa Verde. Tamboo and the wonderful Sandy Beach are just another minute down the road. There is a small convenience store at the bottom of the road as well. Casa Verde and Java Jakes are about 600 meters and the beach is 650 meters. The walk back is uphill so it may not be suitable for the elderly. Backyard:The pool area is amazing with our new pool and waterfall. You may never want to go down to the beach with the new loungers and Adirondacks. The hot tub area does not heat it is only a pool. No worries it's hot enough to swim! The House:Casa Mimosa is a Spanish-style home that is very spacious. Many homes in Puerto Rico have awkward layouts, missing dining rooms, tiny bedrooms, or other quarks. Our house is not like that at all. It is very spacious with a pool table, and a dart board greeting you as you walk into the home. The home features 4 bedrooms and 2 baths. There is a living room that seats 5 adults very comfortably in leather reclining furniture. We have a 75" TV for watching movies in the evening. The dining table seats 6 comfortably. The patio off the living room and the private patio off the master is perfect for viewing the ocean. We have standard drip coffee, an espresso machine, coffee grinder, kettle, and pour over for any coffee lovers out there just pick up a bag on your way to the home. Power outages in Rincon are frequent, very frequent. When vacationing make sure the house has an AUTOMATIC WHOLE HOUSE GENERATOR. If not it could ruin your trip. Luckily our home has a brand new one along with 1600 gallon back up water supply!This property sleeps a MAXIMUM of 9 peopleGuest accessThere is parking inside the gated home for 3-4 cars. Generally, Rincon is pretty spread out and it is recommended that you have a rental car.Other things to notePets must be approved and there will be an additional fee. The pool does NOT have a hot tub. There is a plunge pool attached to the main pool, but the temperature does not change.Puerto Rico and more specifically Rincon have power and water issues with outages. Normally they don’t last more than a few hours but can last 2-3 days. We have an 800-gallon water backup and a whole-house generator. Make sure if you compare other homes they have the same.We do not allow outside guests on the property with the exception of a hired private chef, Massage therapist, etc.We reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on the number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-5 days) Exceptions to the rule applyThere are exterior security cameras at the entry access points on the property. They are a deterrent and not a live feed.We are located on the western point of the island. We are2.5 hours from SJU Airport, 35 minutes from both BQN & MAZ airports and 1.5 hours from PSE Airport in Ponce. To avoid the drive from San Juan there is a Cape Air flight that goes direct multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ.

title: Villa Ventosa - Pool Oasis, King-Size Beds, Solar
description: Unwind & relax in a 4-bed, 4-bath Rincon haven, just moments from the lively town square and iconic Lighthouse. Experience comfort, privacy, and natural beauty. Each room offers a king-sized bed, AC, private bathroom & desks. Savor ocean vistas from the porch, relax by the private pool amidst a lush garden with valley and jungle views. Rest easy with solar-powered backup power & hi-speed satellite wifi. Cook delicious meals in our fully furnished kitchen and BBQ areas with family & friends.The spaceWe invite you to unwind & relax in our haven, where comfort, privacy, and natural beauty converge. Meticulously curated with love and attention, each detail of our house ensures your utmost comfort. You're sure to feel right at home!All four bedrooms offer king-sized beds, air conditioning, private full bathrooms, desks, and ample closet space. Since we're situated on top of a steep hill, our location captures delightful tropical breezes—open your windows and let the soothing sounds of the jungle rock you to sleep.Savor ocean vistas from the entrance porch or unwind by the gated saltwater pool, perched above a lush valley with enchanting jungle views. Lounge in comfort with chairs, a hammock, and plenty of shaded space.Enjoy peace of mind with solar-powered backup and high-speed satellite wifi. In Puerto Rico, power outages are not uncommon, but with our solar and Starlink, you'll be completely unaffected. Create delicious meals in our fully furnished kitchen and BBQ area, perfect for shared meals with family and friends. Gather around the 8-seat dining table or in the spacious living room.Villa Ventosa is the quintessential property for extended families or groups of friends. Welcome to your perfect home away from home!Guest accessVilla Ventosa is the middle unit in a quiet three-story home on a private road. You'll find plenty of parking for up to three vehicles (we recommend renting a car if you're visiting from off the island, as we're located up a steep hill). There are steps to the pool area, but the home itself is stair-free. Your private entrance comes with an electronic touch lock for easy access.Other things to noteOur home operates predominantly on solar power. To contribute to our eco-friendly ethos, we kindly request that you turn off lights and fans when not in use. Additionally, for optimal energy efficiency, please ensure windows and doors are closed while the AC is running and kindly limit its usage to essential times. While we are only 3 min from the town square we are also surrounded by farmland and it is common to hear cows, donkeys, chickens and goats across the valley.
